purpose: Teach: インストラクター/障壁/離職/測量/バリアフリー/粉飾/生計/ステータス

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、防犯インストラクターを学校に派遣しております
lines.en: We dispatch crime prevention instructors to schools.
lines.style: Even, professional tone. Measured cadence. Opens with quiet authority—no rush. States the fact as established policy, neither defensive nor proud.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、入国障壁の引き上げに関与されておられますね
lines.en: Yes. So police are involved in strengthening entry barriers.
lines.style: Attentive nod in the voice. Slight uptick on the affirmation. Checking understanding without questioning—the tone of someone taking notes and confirming the record.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察官の離職を減らすため待遇改善を進めております
lines.en: We're working to improve conditions for officers to reduce turnover.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact delivery. No inflection seeking sympathy. The tone of someone reading from an internal report—thorough, plain, professional.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。現場の測量を警察、迅速に完了されたんですね
lines.en: Yes. And scene surveys were completed promptly by your team.
lines.style: Light affirmation. Slight warmth entering—not friendliness, but recognition of efficiency. The tone of someone noting a job well done in passing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、バリアフリー対応のパトロールを進めております
lines.en: We're also advancing barrier-free accessibility in patrol operations.
lines.style: Steady continuation. No performance in the delivery. Matter-of-fact as the previous statement—these are initiatives, stated as fact, without emphasis seeking credit.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。粉飾決算事件を警察、捜査中ですね
lines.en: Yes. And you're investigating the accounting fraud case.
lines.style: Confirmation with a slight lean forward in attention. The tone sharpens slightly—this is important, concrete work. Respectful acknowledgment of active investigation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の生計復旧支援も行います
lines.en: We also provide support to help victims restore their livelihoods.
lines.style: Quiet conviction entering the voice. Still formal, but something more human beneath—care that doesn't need to announce itself. Steady pace, slight weight on 'restore.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察のステータスは地域の安心の要ですね
lines.en: Yes. Police integrity really is the foundation of community safety.
lines.style: Warmer now, but still measured. A moment of genuine recognition—not flattery, but sincere acknowledgment. The tone of someone who has moved from procedure to meaning.
